item.title: CrowdStrike Falcon agent guidance
item.description: We are aware of an issue that started on 19 July 2024 at 04:09 UTC, which resulted in customers experiencing unresponsiveness and startup failures on Windows machines using the CrowdStrike Falcon agent, affecting both on-premises and various cloud platforms. For additional recovery options please review https://aka.ms/CSfalcon-VMRecoveryOptions
